title: In view of: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 48
content:
## In view of

**Word Power 48 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Considering something; taking something into account.

### Usage

1. In view of the weather, the event will be held indoors.
2. In view of the Corona virus, educational institutions remained closed almost throughout 2020 and online classes were held.

### How to use it

In view of introduces a fact taken into consideration when making a decision. Follow it with a noun phrase or an -ing form. It is more formal than because of in many everyday contexts.

### Another example

In view of the heavy rain, the match has been moved to the indoor hall.

### Check your understanding

Choose: In view of ___ late, we should leave now. (being / be)

### Suggested answer

Being. Of is a preposition, so an -ing form is needed rather than the bare verb be.
